字根型; TWOT - 1705; 動詞

欽定本 - make bare 1, raise up 1, utterly 1, broken 1; 4

06209 `arar {aw-rar'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 1705; v

AV - make bare 1, raise up 1, utterly 1, broken 1; 4

1) to strip, make bare, strip oneself
   1a) (Qal) to strip, strip oneself
   1b) (Poel) to lay bare
   1c) (Hithpalpel) to be utterly stripped, be utterly laid bare
   1d) (Pilpel) break
